selection_method: Round limits to operationally legible units with margin beyond all five observed extrema. These are engineering regression gates for this fixed synthetic scene, not confidence intervals or claims about physical sensor accuracy.
claim_boundary: Only the GAP9 mapping probe on the exact synthetic near-field SDF and square route is covered. This profile does not validate STM32 flight firmware, physical ToF/UWB sensors, multi-drone interaction, or real-world mapping. Any held-out run must use this frozen profile unchanged.
